title: The Worry Pruner (Product Concept)
description: A decision-hygiene product built from the threat-loop mapping: users dump worry-branches; the app FORCES probability estimates, computes expected values, prunes below-threshold branches, and schedules survivors as actions or calendar items. Business model: sober (subscription for value; no variable schedules; arrival designed — the pruned list IS the done state). The concept’s proof: the framework’s most direct productization — a simulator with its update rule repaired, in your pocket. A Signature product concept by Justin Addam Higgins. Conceptual framework only — not medical advice.

title: The Product Ethics Checklist (Ship Gate)
description: A ship-gate checklist from the frameworks: (1) LOOP TEST — does any feature score 3+ on the five engagement tests? (2) FALSIFICATION — can every alarm-state be proven wrong in-product? (3) ARRIVAL — does every flow have a done-state? (4) DECOUPLING — is revenue independent of compulsion? (5) WALL — does any copy approach persons or promise outcomes? Five gates; a feature ships when all pass. The checklist’s power: ethics as PROCESS — not a review at the end but gates throughout. A Signature checklist by Justin Addam Higgins.
